historical_record.description: The L-Ray Arms, architect unknown. Five storeys on a parcel narrow enough to read as a neighbourhood-scale building, put up near the edge of the burned district as rebuilding pressure spread west.

Hearing that rents in the building had nearly doubled in six months ahead of the conversion, the City Planning Commission unanimously found the conversion of its eleven apartments into condominiums not in conformity with the Master Plan (Resolution 7872).
